rows.en: <operator(17040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>. Is something wrong?
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>I feel a piercing will... A power intent on destroying everything.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>I have a bad feeling... Please be careful.
<operator(17010,2)><speed(2)><color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>, stop worrying. I'll wipe that unease away myself.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Faye<ce()>. <color(5)>Berkt<ce()>... is he really over here?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>I can't say for certain. But... we can only trust our choice.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>He's out there about to do something crazy, and here we are doing this? Is that okay?
rows.notes: 'aitsu' (he) = Berkt, per the immediately preceding exchange (0/24-25 naming Berkt).

rows.en: <operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Right, right. Telling us to go poke some weird thing without even explaining why...
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>Right now, I need you all to cooperate. <color(4)>Holland<ce()>'s not wrong about this.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>If <color(4)>Holland<ce()>'s saying that much... I'm curious too.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Coralians... unknown life-forms, huh. I wonder what they're really like.
rows.notes: Casual reference to Coralians as a species ('unknown existence'); not the locked archive title 'unidentified life-forms', so rendered as plain 'unknown life-forms'.

rows.en: <operator(23020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Renton<ce()>... could you stay silent for a bit? My head hurts, and it's hard to concentrate.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Eureka<ce()>... maybe you should skip this sortie and rest instead? It's not worth pushing yourself that far...
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)>I can't do that. Because it's what <color(4)>Holland<ce()> wants.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Renton<ce()>. Once we're inside that thing, you're the only one we can count on.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>If anything happens to <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>, I'll kill you. So do it right.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Y-yes!
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Still, you've turned pretty positive, haven't you.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... I still don't like it, but given the situation, well...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>I've been thinking about it since we got back... Do you still want to back out?
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Huh? Why bring that up now, all of a sudden?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>The fighting's only going to get harder from here. I want to make sure, that's all.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>...I've been thinking about that too.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>But backing out doesn't mean I'd be safe, and everyone else is giving it their all... I can't bail at a time like this.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>If there's something I can actually do... I want to give it a try.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>...Thanks. Hearing you say that honestly puts me at ease.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>You were unreliable at first, but I trust you now. So do your best out there.
<operator(1040,2)><speed(2)>Yeah. Thanks.
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>I wonder what Coralians even are.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>This world's got too many mysteries.
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>Is it really okay for us to be doing this...?
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>They are our comrades. Let's trust them.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Coralians... what in the world are they, anyway.
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>It's making my head spin.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Fighting without even knowing the purpose is a tough ask, huh...
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>But knowing can also drive you into a harder position.
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Holland<ce()> does seem that way, doesn't he. Like he's carrying something and struggling with it...
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Holland<ce()>, what's inside that cloud?
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Who knows... No one's ever gone in.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Want me to go in and find out?
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>...That's not gonna happen.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>I wanna get this operation over with, fast.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Garrod<ce()>... don't rush.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>I... want the power to protect <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>. Strength that won't lose to Newtypes... no, strength to beat them.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Garrod<ce()>, to hold power is to hold sorrow with it. The price of too much power always ends in tragedy.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>We fight so that it never happens again.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>Besides, true strength exists only within each person's heart...
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Shut up! I'm gonna become stronger than anyone. I want to believe in my own strength.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gain<ce()>... Is it really okay for us to be doing this? When the whole world's in danger...
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>That's exactly why this fight is necessary.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I can't fight without a reason!
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Holland<ce()>'s not a man who can't see the situation. Give him that much credit.
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>That's right. Don't be so selfish, <color(4)>Gainer<ce()>.
rows.notes: '-kun' on Gainer dropped, matching the corpus convention for honorifics on locked names.

rows.en: <operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>Getter is calling out to whatever's beyond that cloud...
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>What's that supposed to mean? What are you talking about... <color(4)>Go<ce()>?
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>I don't know. But... that's what Getter is telling me.
